description: Same Classic role + H3 toolkit and unchanged H3 technical reference for all four packages; only one brief Scene Write addendum varies.

packages.hypothesis: Current Classic + H3 toolkit and the unchanged H3 reference are sufficient.
A short affirmative instruction about the image's starting and sustained states improves literal state preservation.
packages.authoring_addendum: Make author-specified visual states explicit at their first visible frame. Describe fixed conditions in directly observable terms and carry them through every relevant timed shot. When a state changes, describe its new appearance as the starting condition for the next shot. Give deliberately still elements concrete visual stability and place surrounding activity in other elements.

packages.hypothesis: Explicit shot interval accounting improves the requested 1–2-second montage rhythm.
packages.authoring_addendum: Translate the author's requested cut lengths into numbered, consecutive [Shot N] intervals. Give each requested 1–2-second shot an explicit start and end time of that length, covering the entire clip from 0s through durationSeconds. Associate a clear visual beat and synchronized audio with each interval. Make the end of one interval the start of the next.

packages.hypothesis: A positive miniature notation example improves exact dialogue and H3 tag placement.
packages.authoring_addendum: Represent each spoken line inside its timed shot with the speaker identity and performance outside the dialogue tag, and the exact spoken words inside the complete H3 tag. Example: Speaker 1 (softly, breathless): <d>[English] We made it.</d> Keep the author's wording, language, speaker assignment and punctuation, with enough on-screen time for the delivery.
